title: Updated ValidateUpdate rejects an unchanged VoteExtensionsEnableHeight once vote extensions are enabled, halting the chain
cause: The update removed ValidateUpdate's equality short-circuit; row 6 rejects any present Abci enable height <= the block height, including one equal to the current, already-reached value.
trigger: With vote extensions enabled, the application's FinalizeBlockResponse re-sends its unchanged Abci.VoteExtensionsEnableHeight (e.g. a complete ConsensusParams echo with a Block change).
consequence: updateState fails, ApplyBlock errors before Commit, consensus panics (CONSENSUS FAILURE) and the restart replay rejects the same block again: every node halts at that height.
premises: Vote extensions are enabled at the executed height (0 < VoteExtensionsEnableHeight <= header.Height).
The application returns ConsensusParamUpdates with a non-nil Abci sub-record equal to the current VoteExtensionsEnableHeight, which the ABCI contract permits (abci++_app_requirements.md:776-789).
Any ApplyBlock error is fatal in consensus and the restart replays the block through the real application deterministically.
